description: This file defines the ConnectException class within the GuzzleHttp library, specifically handling connection errors thrown during HTTP requests. It extends TransferException and implements NetworkExceptionInterface, encapsulating details about the request that failed and handler context information.

classes.name: ConnectException
classes.description: Represents an exception thrown when a connection cannot be established during an HTTP request, holding information about the request and handler context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance of the ConnectException, setting the message, request, previous throwable, and handler context.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request that caused the connection exception.

methods.name: getHandlerContext
methods.description: Provides contextual information about the error from the underlying handler.
